Definition: properly, an expanse, i.e. the firmament or (apparently) visible arch of the sky
BiblicalUsage: 1) extended surface (solid), expanse, firmament; 1a) expanse (flat as base, support); 1b) firmament (of vault of heaven supporting waters above); 1b1) considered by Hebrews as solid and supporting 'waters' above
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
